author: @mark_delight
text: Please write your congress people to demand they enact legislation to refund the illegal tariffs to the US consumers that actually spent the money. Copy what I wrote if you like! [Mr./Ms. REPNAME], I am one of your constituents in [YOUR LOCATION]. Now that the courts have ruled that Trump's tariffs are illegal, and now that a repayment portal has been established so that companies who paid the tariffs importing goods can request refunds of those tariff charges, it's time for you to introduce legislation to repay the American consumers who ultimately had to pay for those tariffs, and have no recourse for refund. Corporations raised the prices of all goods subject to Trump's tariffs, passing those tariff costs on to me, and every other consumer, and I demand to be refunded those extra charges. Please create legislation so that the American People, aka your boss, can be refunded their overpayments due to these illegal tariffs. The corporations who raised our prices should not be repaid, the consumers should be and I look to you to take the lead on getting me my money back please.
